title: Awesome tour!
text: What a great experience! Antonio was so incredibly knowledgeable. Highly recommend this tour. Trying to obtain tickets can be difficult as it’s such a popular destination but this tour took away a lot of the stress surrounding that! Definitely happy with this experience.
author: Heather_R

title: Great for last minute booking to see the Alcazar!
text: This tour was a great option since we were not prepared for the Alcazar tickets which are hard to get and involve long lines if not purchased in advance online. This was a private tour and our guide Juan was very personable, knowledgeable and provided us with so much information surrounding the history of Seville. He made sure to tailor the experience to our interests. The entire booking process with Antonio and his team was very easy with prompt communication. Would highly recommend this tour group.
author: Susan_B

title: Antonio was an excellent...
text: Antonio was an excellent guide, showing us all around the Juderia, Alcázar, and Catedral, deftly moving between English and Spanish.  He has been a guide for 32 years, so had a depth of knowledge of all these places.  This option was a little pricey, but our only choice as I forgot to purchase tickets in advance.  However, having a private guide was well worth it.  The only way Antonio could secure tickets for us was to have someone standing in line at 5:00 am for the same day tickets, which many other tour guides did as well.  Highly recommend this tour.
author: Laura_V

title: Perfect experience,...
text: Perfect experience, everything was smoothly planned and the Guide Viviana was the best we could have ever asked for. Would totally recommend.
author: emanuele_p

title: Alcazar
text: First off, our guide, Raquel was very informative and knowledgeable ! She was very friendly and we never felt rushed. It was very beautiful and  a must see on your list. The Cathedral is stunning, inside and out! Seeing the 3 different facades of the Cathedral from Renaissance, Gothic and Arab was interesting. Raquel was easy going and conversational. Our tour was both interesting and educational. We would 100% recommend this tour and ask for Raquel, if possible!
author: ClaraDenise_M

author: Nabil_W

title: Leisurely private walking tour of two amazing Seville landmarks
text: My guide Antonio was amazing! Intimate knowledge of the Alcázar and the cathedral, expansive knowledge of Spanish history its links to other cultures! During our walk around, he was able to answer all the questions I could throw at him! We would all do these individualised tours if we could afford it!
author: John_L

title: Great tour booked on...
text: Great tour booked on short notice due to a late cancellation from another company.  Got us tickets to a sold out attraction by waiting in line at 6am and had a very informative and great tour.  Recommended!  Thanks
author: Stephen_K

title: Thank you for an amazing tour!
text: Antonio was amazing!!! Our teenage boys also enjoyed the tour so much! He is such a great story teller, kept everyone engaged at all times! And he was able to find last minute tickets for us! Can’t recommend enough!
author: Monica_E

title: Pricey but wonderful
text: We booked a tour after missing out on tickets online to both the cathedral and the Alcazar and were so happy we did. It’s not the cheapest option but Antonio was such a lovely and engaging guide. Well worth the money!
author: Surya_P
